text: People call me JG. I'm a competitor, and I'm good at alchemizing bad times into good ones. Look around and explore my master plan!

All politicians and CEOs should be required to share their raw Spotify wrapped, what they wear when they are lounging at home, and their personal website. This master plan voluntarily exposes my own quirks and nuances. Explore!

S-T-Y-L-E. I know who I am, what I want to say, and I am saying it to you through this collection of snippets and ideas. My master plan is to continue evolving this definition until it becomes a legacy. I'll admit, sometimes I do accidentally agree with things at a function because it's too loud and I can't hear, I'm sorry. Welcome to some of my ideas!

Moses crossed the Red Sea fueled only by milk and honey, I'm curating this personal website fueled by coffee shops and Costco. Watching paint dry isn't too bad if you're in the Sistene Chapel. Welcome to mine, have a look around.

Inside this master plan is a collection of ideas I truly believe will exceed your expectations in shrewdness and discretion, especially in terms of flair. I thought about tacking on 'a gentlemen's' as a unit of measurement just to be more mysterious. I'm interested in cultivating meaningful relationships and meaningful work. Look around to see some of mine.

Hi there. Ideas or projects seem to tug at me, so collecting many of them in a central place might do the same for you. My master plan is to simply have that undefinable quality that makes you stop and pay attention during your busy life. Thanks for reading.

For most of history, the question 'what should one do?' still has the same answer, everywhere. We should be wise, brave, honest, and create value for the world. My master plan is one tiny step towards this idea. Explore some of the ways I'm doing that right here.

My hope for you when you read this is to momentarily forget what a tax Form 1099 is and regain your childlike curiosity. Remember when we used to upload 150 low quality pictures of a thing we did on a Wednesday? It turns out, if we let our master plans out for an onstage interview, they don't get scolded. Instead, you and I start to compare notes. Thanks for reading.

I like to think I contain that vital force, a feature known as heart. I believe curiosity is focus and learning for free. I always take my shopping cart back to the corral. Please take a look around at ideas in my master plan.

Justin Graham is an MIT trained researcher. He is reliable, competent, and a hard worker. Reach out if you want your team's value to increase. Thank you for reading my master plan. Very Respectfully, Justin Graham.
